title: Jamaican Veggie Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and healthy vegetarian dish made with Caribbean-inspired spices, crunchy vegetables, and a hint of tomato.

ingredients.name: Fry Vegetables (such as carrots, potatoes, and onions)

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add fry vegetables and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add jerk seasoning and stir to combine.
Add crushed tomatoes and stir to combine.
Add crunchy bell peppers and cook until tender, about 3 minutes.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
Garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
